grammar.title: 现在完成进行时
grammar.explanation: 现在完成进行时强调从过去某时开始一直持续到现在的动作，并可能继续下去。结构为have/has been + doing。

examples.sentence: I have been waiting for you for two hours.
examples.translation: 我等你等了两个小时了。

examples.sentence: She has been working on this project since January.
examples.translation: 她从一月起就一直在做这个项目。

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思口语Part 2描述持续进行的动作时，现在完成进行时比现在完成时更生动。

speaking.topic: Describe a piece of advice you received
speaking.cueCard: Describe a useful piece of advice you received. You should say: what the advice was / who gave it to you / when you received it / and explain why it was useful.
speaking.sampleAnswer: The most valuable advice I've ever received came from my grandfather when I was agonizing over which university to attend. He simply said, 'Don't choose a path because it's prestigious; choose it because it genuinely interests you.' At the time, I was tempted to pursue a law degree at a top university, partly to impress others. My grandfather's words gave me the courage to follow my true passion for environmental science, even though it meant attending a less renowned institution. This advice proved invaluable because it spared me from years of potential misery in a field I didn't love, and it set me on a career path that I find genuinely fulfilling. More broadly, it taught me to make decisions based on intrinsic motivation rather than external validation, a principle that continues to guide me in both personal and professional life.
speaking.tips: 描述建议时强调其深远影响，体现反思。
